title: HOW TO #10: Cross a Canyon With a Rope Bridge
caption:
How to cross a canyon with a bridge made of rope 🌉🪢

A 60 meter canyon and 1 rope. 10 problems, 10 fixes: a bow shot, 2 thicker ropes, 2 big trees, wooden planks, drilled holes, side ropes at hand height, lines to the cliff walls, metal bars for cracked planks, rope grips, a second layer under the planks. A 60 meter rope bridge that holds 5 people at once.

Would you cross it with your eyes open or closed? Comment CROSS below. Tag the friend who is afraid of heights. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #11!
